question: Does MW cf. inherit PWG Vgl.? (LEXICOGRAPHY_ROADMAP §3.1)
method: Normalize both ends of every m3 edge (strip compound marker °/-, SLP1 accents, stray hyphens), dedupe per dict, then intersect edge sets restricted to source lemmas both dicts cross-reference. Overlap is a FLOOR (messy targets fail to match).
verdict_mw_pwg: PARTIAL overlap — a shared cross-reference CORE (MW 22% / PWG 9% of cross-refs on lemmas both treat, well above chance) plus large independent expansion in each tradition; NOT wholesale inheritance
